info.title: Hubnovo World — Competitions API
info.description:
REST API for the **Campus Competition** (Career & Employability + Enterprise Development pathways) — used by the mobile app and the web.

**Auth:** `Authorization: Bearer <Supabase access token>` (same token as the ModusHive/Livestream API).

**Responses:** success → `200 { "ok": true, ...fields }`. Error → `{ "error": "message" }` with 400 (show the message), 401, 403 (admin only), 404 (also for a competition you can’t play yet), 429 (120 req/min), 500.

**Points:** XP = progress & level. HubTokens = closed-loop, non-cash credits (no cash-out, no transfers).

**Time:** ISO-8601 UTC. Semesters run on Lagos time (UTC+1); day 1 = Monday, day 7 = Sunday (boss day).

**Access:** the Campus Competition is `live` — any signed-in user can join. (A competition in `preview` is limited to admins and testers.)

**Notifications:** Campus events (daily quest open at 07:00 Lagos, Sunday boss live, judge results, appeal results, squad joins/leader changes) are rows in `public.notifications` with `type = 'competition'`. Show `title` + `body`; open `data.url` (a web path such as `/app/competitions/campus/missions/{id}` or `/app/competitions/campus/squad` → map to the app screen). `data.kind` is `world_quest`, `world_attempt` or `world_squad`; `reference_id` (and `data.resource_id`) the mission / attempt / squad id. Push goes out through the existing OneSignal trigger.
**App flow:** `GET /competitions` → `GET /competitions/campus` (me = null → onboarding) → `GET /institutions` → `POST …/join` → home `GET …/quests/today` → mission `GET …/missions/{id}` → uploads → `POST …/attempts` → `GET …/progress`, `…/leaderboard`, `…/league`.

Shared TypeScript types: `lib/world/types.ts` in the web repo.

post.description:
For `file` and `video` fields. Then **PUT** the raw file to `uploadUrl` with the same `Content-Type`, and use `{ "key": "<key>" }` as that field’s value.

Allowed: jpeg/png/webp & pdf ≤ 10 MB; mp4/mov/webm ≤ 150 MB — only the groups in the field’s `accept`.

post.description:
Body shape depends on the mission `kind` (quiz / sort / scenario / form).

**Result `attempt.status`:** `passed` (XP + HubTokens awarded once) · `needs_revision` (show feedback, retry up to `maxAttempts`) · `in_review` (judge/moderator — poll the mission later) · `rejected` (final; can appeal).

Quiz/sort/scenario are graded instantly and the **first attempt** counts toward the stage score. Written missions are scored by the AI reviewer against the rubric. Personal data about other people → `needs_revision`.

post.summary: Ask the Novo coach about a mission
post.description: In-mission AI coach. It explains the brief and rubric, asks guiding questions and gives outlines, but **never writes the submission** or reveals quiz answers. Off for judged missions (Sunday boss challenges and the Week 4 finale): returns 400, so hide the button when `kind` is `boss` or `reviewMode` is `human`. Mission context is loaded on the server. Limit: 30 messages per user per day (429). Keep `history` on the device (last 8 turns are used).

counts.description: Totals across the whole queue (for badges).

MissionKind.description: `quiz`, `sort`, `scenario` have their own config. Every other kind uses `FormConfig`.

ScoreBucket.description: Stage score weights: evidence 40%, quality 25%, reflection 15%, teamwork 10%, showcase 10%.

ReviewMode.description: `auto` graded instantly (or completion), `ai` scored by the AI reviewer against the rubric, `human` judged (Sunday boss / stage finale).

status.description: `preview` is only shown to admins/testers; everyone else sees `coming_soon`.

QuizProfile.description: Self-assessment result profile: what each answer option id means.

QuizInsights.description: Ranked self-assessment result, e.g. the Skill Compass. Show it instead of a score.

graded.description: false = self-assessment (no right answers; completing it passes)

next.description: next node id; absent = scenario ends

repeat.description: Send an array of this many values (e.g. "Why? ×5").

variant.description: UI hint: five_whys, scorecard, goal_forge, lean_canvas, value_proposition, star, unit_economics, mock_interview, business_canvas, competitor_map, interview_script, problem_map, route_planner, comparison

checklist.description: Every item must be ticked — send their ids in `checklist`.

tips.description: "How to do this": 1–3 practical steps to show above the activity.

FieldValue.description: text/textarea → string · number → number · select → option id · checkbox → boolean · link → {url} · file/video → {key from upload-url}

path.description: Start at `start`, follow each choice’s `next` until a choice has none.

checklist.description: ids of the ticked checklist items (all are required)

character.description: 3D avatar 0–11 — show its preview when avatarUrl is null

anyOf.description: Stream channel (type messaging) — connect with /api/stream-token, call POST …/squad/chat first

config.description: Mission config (form fields + checklist) — use the field labels to show the answers.

current.description: Where the attempt stands now. For appeals this is the result being appealed.

AnswerKey.description: Server-only answer key (saved to competition_mission_keys, never sent to students). quiz → `{ correct: { questionId: optionId | optionId[] } }` · sort → `{ correct: { itemId: binId } }` · scenario → `{ scores: { choiceId: 0–100 } }`. Required for graded quizzes, sorts and scenarios; ignored for other kinds.

MissionInput.description: Same shape as `SeedMission` in lib/world/content. Rules: day 7 = `boss` (reviewMode `human`); the day-7 boss of weeks 4, 8, 12, 16 is the stage finale (rubricKey `showcase` + a badge); `ai`/`human` review needs a rubric; one active mission per pathway/week/day.

key.description: Optional; generated as c-w5-d1 / e-w5-d1 when omitted

isActive.description: false = saved but hidden from students

AdminMission.description: A mission as the content editor sees it (admins only — includes the answer key).

attempts.description: Student attempts. Missions with attempts are never deleted, only switched off; kind and pathway are locked.

ready.description: 7 active missions, one per day, Sunday boss (finale on weeks 4/8/12/16)

error.description: Human-readable — show it to the user

E400.description: Invalid input or rule broken — show `error` to the user

E404.description: Not found, or a competition you can’t play yet
